prompt:
A digital stopwatch displays '14.8 s'.
(a) State the numerical magnitude of this measurement. [1]
(b) State the unit of this measurement. [1]
hints: The numerical magnitude is just the numeric value.
The unit is the symbol or word that defines the scale.
solution:
(a) The numerical magnitude is the number itself: 14.8.
(b) The unit is seconds, represented by the symbol s.
teacher_walkthrough: Two straightforward marking points isolating each constituent part of a recorded value.
Verify that students do not attach 's' to part (a).

provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original item isolating magnitude and unit.
